text:
Situation: Atropine sulfate has been on the FDA shortage list since 2012-01-01 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 178 months. Corvale East holds 8.9 days on hand across three presentations; Corvale General holds 16 days on hand across three lots; Corvale Lakeside holds 13 to 16 days on hand for two presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, and Warning Letters on 2010-04-12 and 2011-08-31. American Regent (FEI 2410375) received an OAI classification on 2011-03-15 and a Warning Letter on 2011-08-31. All actions occurred before the shortage posting date.

Our position: We have verified supply from Hospira and Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC (FEI 3010254278). Corvale General can transfer 20 units to Corvale East, extending East to 11 days while General retains two weeks. Four alternate distributors are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels do not name a plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Approve transfer of 20 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Authorize buyer to evaluate purchase from A-S Medication Solutions — requires buyer execution.
3. Authorize buyer to evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — requires buyer execution.
4. Authorize buyer to evaluate purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst — requires buyer execution.
5. Authorize buyer to evaluate purchase from HF Acquisition Co. LLC, DBA Health First — requires buyer execution.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
